tests.title: Section A: Applied Biochemistry (25 marks)
tests.patternSource: INC B.Sc Nursing Regulations 2020, Appendix 3 (university theory question paper pattern): Applied Biochemistry is Section A (25 marks) of a combined 3-hour, 75-mark paper shared with Applied Nutrition and Dietetics (Section B, 50 marks). Section A has no essay and no internal choice. This mock covers Section A only, timed at about one third of the paper. Confirm with your university.
